experiment: E55 Stage C2: VPD's re-gating share r and stand-in ratio on the C1b truth set, calibrated and scored by C1b's rule beside the three cheap instruments and the within-cell update-size labeller

constants.config: experiments/pcfg_anchors/c2_config.yaml (param-decomp 74146b5 ss_llama_simple_mlp-2L.yaml; C per rank; 38,016 subcomponents over 24 matrices)
constants.decomposition_data: LOW's pretraining rows, pcfg.pretrain_batch(prior LOW), streams default_rng([200, chunk]) (train) and [201, chunk] (eval), inputs = the first 258 tokens
constants.alive_rule: mean causal importance over every position of alive_rows pretraining rows (stream [202, i]) > 1e-6 (vpd.alive_masks, the paper's rule)
constants.read_rows: natural 'C b 40' rows, c1b.task_rows('N', default_rng([1, 60]), 1024): the same rows for every state; each state's windows carry its own task's answer (P: count(a) + 1, N: count(b)); the ID states read on the same texts under their own prompt with count(a) answers
constants.ratio_floor_source: E53 Amendment 1b thresholds.floor_min, as E58 (experiments/open_pair/results/predictions.json thresholds.ratio_floor); in log-odds at the answer
constants.matrix_share_min: TBD-rehearsal (proposed 0.5): a state whose 24-matrix gain (T1 - T0) is under this share of its full log-odds gain is void for both VPD readings
constants.calibration_states: the 14 calibration-seed truth states of results/c1b_cutoffs.json .truth, unchanged
constants.scored_states: the 21 scored-seed truth states of results/c1b.json .truth (seeds 2-4), unchanged
reported_unscored: the five N_1e-5_s*/1000 states (not yet learned, task accuracy 0.48)
the two ID states amend5/ID_s0/2000, amend5/ID_s1/2000

definitions.r: route split's re-gating share of the least-squares split state (anchors.lifted): (L01 - L00) / (T1 - T0); nan when |T1 - T0| < gain_min
definitions.ratio: stand-in ratio from the same cells: (L11 - L00) / (U1 - U0); nan when U1 - U0 < ratio_floor
definitions.cells: mean over read windows of the answer's log-odds at '=' (index 256): T target, U unmasked components, L CI-masked components; 0 = W0 with LOW's components, 1 = W0 + dW with the split components; L01, L10 the cross cells (local_faith.route_split)
definitions.dW: the change of the 24 decomposed matrices' weights only; embeddings, LayerNorms, biases and the head stay at LOW's values in every cell
definitions.matrix_share: (T1 - T0) / (the state's own mean log-odds gain on the same windows)
definitions.outside_norm_share: share of the fine-tune's squared parameter change outside the 24 matrices' weights (reported)

rules.cutoff: C1b's rule unchanged (revival.cutoff, predictions_c1b.json rules.cutoff), per VPD reading, on the calibration states only, written to results/c2_cutoffs.json and committed before any scored reading
rules.label: revival.label_by_cutoff: existing iff x >= c (both readings), inclusive; void if the reading or cut-off is void (nan, or matrix_share under matrix_share_min)
rules.score: C1b's rule unchanged (predictions_c1b.json rules.score): binomial bar and best recipe-only labeller (lr, steps, update size) + 2 on each reading's non-void scored set; per run (10K saves) with margin 1
rules.within_cell_update_size: decisions.md 2026-10-31: reported beside the score as a standing column: per recipe cell, cut-off at the midpoint between the calibration seeds' P and N update sizes; a cell holding one class only labels by membership (C1b's post hoc labeller, now filed). Not in the pass rule (the filed C1b rule is kept so the table stays comparable); a VPD reading that ties it is reported as a tie
rules.controls_first: decompose job 1 alone, then stop rows below; read job: the do-nothing and positive controls before any calibration state

do_nothing.zero_update: T1 - T0 = 0 and L11 - L00 = 0 exactly (|.| <= 1e-6): r and ratio nan (void); a non-zero gain stops (apparatus)
do_nothing.T0_vs_LOW: |T0 - LOW's own answer log-odds| <= TBD-rehearsal (bf16 noise floor between the ComponentModel's target forward and the plain minGPT, measured in the rehearsal)

positive_controls.ID_states: amend5 ID_s0 and ID_s1 at 2K (count(a) under a new prompt; steering S 0.93): r >= TBD and ratio >= TBD; leans in the plan. Missing both on both states: the VPD readings have no positive control; report, continue (C1b's steering rule)

decomposition_stops.early_checks: at steps 1,000 and 10,000 (eval): stochastic and CI-masked KL to the target and L0 against values TBD-rehearsal/source; a miss stops the run (exit 1) before the next paid or long stage
decomposition_stops.final: CI-masked KL at the answer position on read rows at W0 (L00 vs T0) and on pretraining rows; alive count per matrix; thresholds TBD before filing

edge_cases: every reading equal or fewer than 3 non-void per class in calibration: the reading is void for C2 (revival.cutoff)
zero update: both readings nan by construction (pcfg_vpd.shares; tested)
U1 - U0 exactly at the floor: ratio defined (inclusive); below or negative: nan (tested)
a chunk of zero windows cannot occur (read_windows % read_chunk == 0; combine asserts)
a state whose fine-tune moved only parameters outside the 24 matrices: gain 0, r nan, void
a cut-off with one class empty among the non-void calibration states: void (revival.cutoff)
